title: 第010章 热情和善的大叔
content_zh:
刘邦和那位中年男人就这样走向了亭阁，边走边聊，刘邦是相当的惬意，光着脚，有说有笑的聊着天，仿佛两人不是君臣，而是一对真正的老朋友。
刘邦的这位老朋友，脾气很是张狂，刘邦跟他谈起了几个开国将领，可这位老朋友却将那些将领痛斥了一顿，仿佛这些人加在一起都不够他看的，言语里充斥着对这些人的不屑。
“朕听说，前些时日你去拜访樊哙，樊哙是以跪拜礼恭迎恭送，并说：大王竟肯光临臣下家门，真是臣下的光耀。”
“嗯，臣也很感动。”
“可是朕听说，你在出门之后，笑着对左右说：我这辈子居然同樊哙等同列！可有此事？”
中年人脸色一变，随即冷漠的说道：“他本就不及我，这话又有什么不对呢？”
刘邦放声大笑，“要是樊哙听到这句话，他一定会很难过，他平日里那么的爱戴你。”
两人继续走着，刘邦这才问道：“我们说了很多的将军，却漏掉了两个人。”
“哦？”
“朕。”
“你说朕这样的才能，能统帅多少士卒呢？”
“陛下所能率领的，不会超过十万人。”
“那你呢？你的才能可以统帅多少士卒呢？”
“越多越好，上不封顶。”
刘邦戏虐的看着他，“如此看来，朕还是要胜你一筹的。”
“哦？”
“你能带的士卒越多越好，可为什么还被朕抓住了呢？”
中年男子的眼角跳了跳，脸色瞬间变得赤红，可是面对刘邦那戏虐的表情，他很快又平静了下来，认真的说道：“陛下不善于统领士卒，可您善于统帅将领，这就是我被陛下抓住的原因。”
“还有呢？”
“陛下的位置是上天赐予的，不是人力能做到的，这也是我被抓住的原因。”

“说的好啊！”
刘邦果真大喜，正要仰天大笑，却听中年男子又说道：“不过....”
“陛下虽善于管教将领，可陛下对建筑的审美似乎不是很好。”
刘邦大吃一惊，问道：“你为什么要这么说呢？”
中年男子淡然的指着远处的亭阁，问道：“这是陛下有意而为的吗？”
刘邦转身看去，只见主亭阁四周的护栏被拆的七七八八，好几个地方都露出了空白，没来得及被拆走的护栏在风中摇摇晃晃的，地上甚至有木屑，几块断开的木头，刘邦看懵了，呆若木鸡，一动不动。
“不是吗？”
“那就是皇宫里有人偷走了陛下的木头。”
中年男子继续补刀。
“来人啊！！”
刘邦一声怒吼，远处的那些甲士们迅速冲到了刘邦的身边，单膝跪在了他的面前。
刘邦脸色赤红，眼睛里仿佛都在燃烧着怒火，“居然有人敢拆朕的亭阁！偷朕的木头！”
“给我去查！把那个偷东西的毛贼给朕带回来！”
甲士们顿时跑着离开了，当然，还剩下了两位，紧盯着那位中年男子。
......
刘长扛着手锯，哼着小曲，大摇大摆的在碎石道上走着，自己还真的是发现了个不错的地方，长的，方的，园的，各种木料都能找的到，今天再弄一些方的木料，基本上材料就够用了。
这个手锯实在是太小，要是有个斧子就好了。
刘长正想着呢，忽然，他被一道阴影所笼罩，刘长缓缓抬起头来，却是四五个虎狼一样的高大甲士，这些人低着头，惊愕的看着扛着手锯的刘长。
“哇..你们真高啊，你们腰间那柄剑能不能借我看看？哎？你们想做什么？我是七公子！家父汉...”
刘邦冷冷的看着在寒风里瑟瑟发抖的刘长，他身后站着二十多位全副武装的甲士，一旁还放着他的作案工具。

“原来是家贼啊...”
刘邦很好面子，或者说，在登基之后，非常的好面子，刘长若是其他时候被他抓住，或许他不会多说什么。可问题是，此刻刘邦身边还站着人，在这个人面前丢了面子，这是刘邦最不能忍受的。
“竖子！你为什么要拆朕的亭阁？”
“阿父...我不知道这是你的亭阁啊...我看平日里也没人来..”
“不是朕的就可以拆了吗？”
刘邦愤怒的说着，缓缓从地上捡起了鞋，刘长缩了缩脖子，眼神迅速瞄了一下四周，四周都是冷着脸的甲士，根本逃不出去。
“不是，阿父...你听我说。”
“我去天禄阁读书，老师说，当孩子的要为母亲尽孝，当皇子的要为天下谋福利，您说，老师说的对吗？”
“老师让你来拆朕的亭阁？”
“不是，我只是想要做点事情，我看阿母用那个纺车非常的幸苦，所以就想要做一个便捷的纺车，可是我没有木料，所以只能来拆这些房屋了...”，刘长迅速说着，他看到刘邦拿着鞋的手越来越高，语速也就越来越快。
“何况，要是真的有一台可以增加纺织效率的机器，妇人也可以此养家，养桑人大获其益，国库收入亦增，最重要的是...天下人都能穿得起衣裳，这寒冬也就不会那么难熬了。”
刘邦忽然愣住了，他有些狐疑的看着刘长，这话居然是刘长这个混蛋说出来的？
“陛下，若是殿下真有这样的心思，便是将整个亭阁拆了又如何？修建亭阁容易，可是想要教导皇子却很难啊。”
中年男子冷漠的说着，也算是给了刘邦一个台阶。
刘邦点了点头，这才又将鞋履穿上。
刘长呼出了一口气。
感谢四哥，感谢这位陌生大叔。
“这位先生一看就是有文化的人，多谢，多谢。”
刘邦脸色一黑，却没有再发火。
“敢问阁下大名？”

“韩信。”
“我勒个大....”
刘长瞪大了双眼，急忙走到了韩信的面前，上下打量着他，眼神火热，“您真的是韩信？”
韩信也不知道面前这小屁孩怎么这么一副表情，但很是很淡定的点了点头。
刘邦嗤笑着说道：“你个不学无术的竖子还知道韩信？”
“兵仙啊...谁不知道！”
就是刘长这样的历史半吊子，也知道韩信的大名，毕竟在后世，这位的名声很大，甚至在某种程度上，已经超过了其他同僚，直逼刘邦，当初刘长知道面前的男人是刘邦之后，也曾很激动，可是因为太熟悉，很快就没有什么感觉了。
但是这次不同，忽然遇到传说中的兵仙，刘长激动的有些过头了。
韩信倒是很平静，刘邦就有些不太舒服了，自家孩子如此崇拜自己的“对手”，没错，某位不愿意透露姓名的大汉王朝的开辟者刘某觉得有些酸，朕不必这厮更牛？这都被抓进京城了，还兵仙？等他走了，一定给你见识一下什么叫鞋仙。
刘长喋喋不休的问起了韩信的经历，问他当初是怎么打败了强大不可一世的西楚霸王。
面对那些过去的经历，韩信都有些恍惚，眼神黯淡。
刘邦几次尝试着插嘴，可刘长压根不理会他。
韩信眯了眯双眼，问道：“你喜欢兵法？”
“披着一身盔甲，骑着高头大马，率领骑士们在战场上飞驰，攻城略地，哪个男儿不喜欢呢？”
韩信忽然抬起头来，看着刘邦，笑着问道：“我跟公子倒是很投缘，要不就让他跟着我学习吧？我的本事也好有人继承下来。”
刘邦眯起了双眼，轻笑着说道：“好啊。”
韩信摸了摸刘长的头，说道：“以后有机会就来找我，我教你怎么打仗。”
刘长目瞪口呆，什么情况？
韩信要教我兵法？
直到韩信离开，刘长都在那种巨大的惊诧之中，他觉得这实在是太不可思议了，自己居然成了韩信的弟子？？？

“呵，人已经走了，想什么呢？”
刘长猛地抬起头来，问道：“阿父，能不能再让萧何教我治理政务，让张良教我出谋划策？”
“滚！！！”
.......
走出了皇宫，韩信的脸瞬间变得冰冷，他打量着站在马车身边的几个心腹，一声不吭的坐上了马车，当马车缓缓朝着他的府邸行驶而去的时候，韩信抬起头来，眼里满是冰冷的杀意。
content_en:
Liu Bang and the middle-aged man walked towards the pavilion and chatted while walking. Liu Bang was quite comfortable, barefoot, chatting and laughing, as if the two were not monarchs and ministers, but a pair of real old friends.
Liu Bang's old friend had a very arrogant temper. Liu Bang talked to him about several founding generals, but this old friend scolded those generals, as if these people together were not enough for him, and his words were full of disdain for these people.
"I heard that you visited Fan Kuai a few days ago. Fan Kuai bowed down to greet you and sent you off, and said: Your Majesty is willing to visit your home. It is really a honor for me."
"Well, I am also very touched."
"But I heard that after you went out, you smiled and said to the people around you: I have been ranked with Fan Kuai and others in this life! Is this possible?"
The middle-aged man's expression changed, and then he said indifferently: "He is not as good as me, so what's wrong with that?"
Liu Bang laughed loudly, "If Fan Kuai hears this, he will definitely be sad. He loves you so much."
The two continued walking, and Liu Bang asked: "We talked about a lot of generals, but we missed two people."
"Oh?"
"Me."
"How many soldiers do you think I can command with my talent?"
"Your Majesty can lead no more than 100,000 people."
"What about you? How many soldiers can you command with your talents?"
"The more the better, there is no limit."
Liu Bang looked at him teasingly, "Looks like I'm still better than you."
"Oh?"
"The more soldiers you can bring, the better, but why were you caught by me?"
The corners of the middle-aged man's eyes twitched, and his face instantly turned red. However, facing Liu Bang's playful expression, he quickly calmed down and said seriously: "Your Majesty is not good at commanding soldiers, but you are good at commanding generals. This is why I was caught by Your Majesty."
"What else?"
"Your Majesty's position was given by God and cannot be achieved by human power. This is why I was caught."
"Well said!"
Liu Bang was really overjoyed and was about to look up to the sky and laugh when he heard the middle-aged man say again: "But..."
"Although His Majesty is good at disciplining generals, His Majesty's aesthetic appreciation of architecture does not seem to be very good."
Liu Bang was shocked and asked, "Why do you say that?"
The middle-aged man pointed calmly to the pavilion in the distance and asked, "Did your Majesty do this intentionally?"
Liu Bang turned around and looked around, only to see that the guardrails around the main pavilion had been torn down in pieces, with gaps exposed in many places. The guardrails that had not been removed in time were swaying in the wind, and there were even sawdust and several broken pieces of wood on the ground. Liu Bang was stunned, dumbfounded, and motionless.
"Isn't it?"
"That means someone in the palace stole His Majesty's wood."
The middle-aged man continued to hit the target.
"Someone is coming!!"
Liu Bang roared angrily, and the soldiers in the distance quickly rushed to Liu Bang's side and knelt on one knee in front of him.
Liu Bang's face was red, and his eyes seemed to be burning with anger, "Someone dares to demolish my pavilion! Steal my wood!"
"Check it out for me! Bring me back that thief!"
The soldiers immediately ran away. Of course, there were two left, staring closely at the middle-aged man.
...
Liu Chang carried the hand saw, hummed a tune, and walked struttingly on the gravel road. He really found a good place. Long, square, garden, and all kinds of wood can be found. Today, I will get some square wood. Basically, the materials are enough.
This hand saw is too small, it would be nice to have an axe.
Liu Chang was thinking about it when suddenly, he was enveloped by a shadow. Liu Chang slowly raised his head, but there were four or five tall soldiers who looked like tigers and wolves. These people lowered their heads and looked at Liu Chang who was carrying a hand saw in shock.
"Wow..you guys are reallyGao, can you lend me the sword on your waist? Why? What do you want to do? I am the Seventh Young Master! My father-in-law..."
Liu Bang looked coldly at Liu Chang, who was shivering in the cold wind. Behind him stood more than 20 fully armed soldiers, and his crime tools were placed beside him.
"It turns out to be a house thief..."
Liu Bang has a lot of face, or in other words, he has a lot of face after he ascended the throne. If Liu Chang were caught by him at other times, he might not say much. But the problem is that there is still someone standing next to Liu Bang at this moment, and losing face in front of this person is what Liu Bang can't bear the most.
"Shuzi! Why do you want to demolish my pavilion? "
"Father...I didn't know this was your pavilion...I don't think anyone comes here on weekdays..."
“Can’t it be dismantled if it’s not mine? "
Liu Bang said angrily and slowly picked up the shoes from the ground. Liu Chang shrank his neck and quickly glanced around. He was surrounded by cold-faced soldiers and there was no way to escape.
"No, Father...listen to me. "
"I went to Tianlu Pavilion to study, and the teacher said that children should be filial to their mothers, and princes should seek the welfare of the world. Do you think the teacher is right? "
"Teacher asked you to demolish my pavilion? "
"No, I just want to do something. I saw that my grandma was having a hard time with that spinning wheel, so I wanted to make a convenient spinning wheel. But I don't have wood, so I have to demolish these houses..." Liu Chang spoke quickly. He saw Liu Bang's hand holding the shoe getting higher and higher, and his speaking speed getting faster and faster.
"What's more, if there is a machine that can increase the efficiency of weaving, women can also support their families, people who raise mulberry trees will benefit greatly, and the revenue of the national treasury will also increase. The most important thing is... everyone in the world can afford to wear clothes, and this cold winter will not be so difficult. "
Liu Bang was suddenly stunned. He looked at Liu Chang suspiciously. These words were actually said by the bastard Liu Chang?
"Your Majesty, if His Highness really has such thoughts, what if he demolishes the entire pavilion? It is easy to build a pavilion, but it is difficult to teach the prince. "
The middle-aged man said indifferently, which could be regarded as giving Liu Bang a step forward.
Liu Bang nodded and then put on his shoes again.
Liu Chang exhaled.
Thank you Fourth Brother, thank you to this strange uncle.
“This gentleman looks like an educated person at first glance, thank you, thank you very much. "
Liu Bang's face darkened, but he didn't get angry again.
"May I ask your name? "
"Han Xin. "
"I'll strangle you..."
Liu Chang's eyes widened and he hurriedly walked up to Han Xin, looking him up and down with fiery eyes, "Are you really Han Xin? "
Han Xin didn't know why the little kid in front of him had such an expression, but he nodded very calmly.
Liu Bang sneered and said, "You ignorant fool still know about Han Xin? "
"Bing Xian...who doesn't know! "
Even a dabbler in history like Liu Chang knew Han Xin's name. After all, in later generations, this man's reputation was very great, and to some extent, he had surpassed other colleagues, approaching Liu Bang. When Liu Chang knew that the man in front of him was Liu Bang, he was very excited, but because he was so familiar, he soon lost any feeling.
But this time it was different. Liu Chang was overly excited when he suddenly met the legendary Soldier Immortal.
Han Xin was very calm, but Liu Bang felt a little uncomfortable. His children admired his "rival" so much. Yes, Liu, the founder of the Han Dynasty who did not want to be named, felt a little bitter. I don't need to be more awesome? They've all been captured and taken to the capital, how about returning soldiers to the Immortal? After he leaves, I will show you what a shoe fairy is.
Liu Chang kept asking about Han Xin's experience and how he defeated the powerful Overlord of Western Chu.
Facing those past experiences, Han Xin was in a daze and his eyes were dim.
LiuBang tried to interrupt several times, but Liu Chang ignored him at all.
Han Xin narrowed his eyes and asked, "Do you like the art of war?"
"Wearing a suit of armor, riding a tall horse, leading the knights to gallop on the battlefield, conquering cities and territories, what man wouldn't like it?"
Han Xin suddenly raised his head, looked at Liu Bang, and asked with a smile: "Young Master and I really like each other very well. Why don't you let him learn from me? Someone can inherit my skills."
Liu Bang narrowed his eyes, chuckled and said, "Okay."
Han Xin touched Liu Chang's head and said, "Come to me when you have the opportunity, and I will teach you how to fight."
Liu Chang was stunned, what happened?
Han Xin wants to teach me the art of war?
Until Han Xin left, Liu Chang was in a state of huge surprise. He thought this was really incredible. He actually became Han Xin's disciple? ? ?
"Oh, he's gone, what are you thinking about?"
Liu Chang raised his head suddenly and asked: "Father, can you let Xiao He teach me how to manage government affairs and Zhang Liang teach me how to make plans?"
"Go away!!!"
.......
After walking out of the palace, Han Xin's face turned cold instantly. He looked at his confidants standing beside the carriage and got on the carriage without saying a word. When the carriage slowly drove towards his mansion, Han Xin raised his head, his eyes full of cold murderous intent.
